title: Harness pending-protect: do not shrink the Pending list blindly
desc: Blocks an action that would drop CLAUDE.md Pending items without recording progress, forcing the AI to reflect (mark done or add a new finding) before history dirties.
steps: TRIGGER: fires when the Pending count in CLAUDE.md decreased relative to the session baseline without a corresponding done-mark or new item.
FIX: edit CLAUDE.md Pending -- mark the resolved item [x] with a one-line note, or add the new finding [ ], then retry. The gate forces self-reflection before the commit history changes.
WHY: silently shrinking Pending loses tracked work; CLAUDE.md is canonical -- if it is not there, it does not exist. See: claude-md-todo-sync, claude-md-guide.
author: claude
